cards.existing: `Любить` (to love) works normally – subject = liker, object = liked: `Я люблю кофе`. Use `нравиться` for 'like', `любить` for 'love'.

cards.existing: Polite requests use бы: `Я хотел бы` (Ya khotel by) (I would like – softer than `я хочу`). Adding бы to a wish softens it considerably.

cards.english: He would write a book.
cards.existing: бы (by) + past = conditional. Я хотел бы пойти = I would like to go. если бы я знал = if I knew. Uses past form for hypothetical meaning.

cards.english: She is angry with her brother.
The children are playing in the yard.
This book is more interesting than that one.
This tea is more expensive than that one.
cards.existing: Exceptions: nouns ending in `-ь` can be either masc or fem – `день` (day, m), `ночь` (night, f). Memorize these. Some `-а` nouns are masc by meaning: `папа`, `дядя`, `мужчина`.

cards.english: This restaurant is more popular than that one.

I would read this book.

cards.existing: Some imperatives are irregular: `дать (dat') → дай`, `есть → ешь`. Memorize the common ones; they appear constantly in everyday speech.

cards.english: I would like a cup of coffee.
We would like to book a table.

cards.target: Мы бы не отказались от помощи.
cards.english: We would not refuse help.
cards.existing: бы (by) + past = conditional. Я хотел бы пойти = I would like to go. если бы я знал = if I knew. Uses past form for hypothetical meaning.

cards.target: Если бы я только знал тогда.
cards.english: If only I had known then.
That's why I think so.
cards.existing: Russian has NO articles (no 'the' or 'a/an'). `Это книга` = 'this [is] a/the book'. The article is left to context and intonation.

cards.target: Мы бы подождали, если бы знали.
cards.english: We would have waited if we had known.

cards.target: Если бы не работа, я бы поспал.
cards.english: If it weren't for work, I would have slept.
cards.existing: `Если бы + past, ... бы + past` = 'if ... then would ...': `Если бы я знал, я бы пришёл` (If I had known, I would have come). Both halves take бы.

cards.target: Если бы я знал, я бы пришёл.
cards.english: If I had known, I would have come.
